items.why: Nvidia soars after the board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, with Trump cheering his return, lifting chip stocks across the board.
Volatility plunges as the Nasdaq roars back 7% and the S&P 500 rebounds 5% on the Nvidia news.

summary: Stocks are roaring back, with the Nasdaq up about 7% and the S&P 500 rebounding 5% as Nvidia surges on Jensen Huang returning as CEO. The sharp rebound follows a steep slide, with volatility plunging as buyers step back in.
